issues.display_title: Issue #1863: Fallback to default avatar icon when avatar image fails to load
issues.main_description_html:
Description

When a user's avatar image fails to load (e.g. broken image URL, 404, or network error), the avatar displays as a broken image icon rather than falling back to the standard default user avatar SVG icon.

Expected Behavior

If an avatar image encounters an error during loading, it should gracefully fall back to displaying the default avatar SVG icon.

Scope / Affected Components

  • Header (src/app/layouts/header/)
  • Sidebar / Sidemenu (src/app/layouts/sidemenu/)
  • Profile Settings Avatar Upload (src/app/pages/settings/profile-setting/avatar-upload/)
  • User Update (src/app/pages/profile/user-update/)
  • Profile Information (src/app/pages/profile/information/)
  • White Label Information (src/app/components/white-label/information/)
  • Support Table (src/app/pages/support/)
